A great quick weeknight dinner is **One-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken with Veggies**:

**Ingredients:** 2 chicken breasts, 1 lb baby potatoes (halved), 1 broccoli crown (cut), 3 tbsp olive oil, 4 garlic cloves (minced), 1 lemon (juiced + zested), 1 tsp oregano, salt/pepper.

**Method:** Toss chicken & veggies with oil, garlic, lemon, oregano, S&P on a sheet pan. Roast 425°F 20–25 min until chicken hits 165°F. Done in 30 min with minimal cleanup.

PLAN: Provide the recipe directly to the user. No external tools needed.
